rows.cellular_context: A549, verified in raw CP and linked GE metadata
rows.paired_ge_role: Linked GE is used as update evidence for CP; it is not an independent external GE-target validation in these figures.
rows.morphology_reference_design: Reference averages four physical plate rows excluding the current support; two frozen support rotations are retained. Rotations do not create additional experimental replicates.

rows.readout: Single-cell GE pseudobulk; A549, K562, MCF7
rows.measurement_design: Two biological repeats; held-out cell line/plate block
rows.role_scope: Downstream prediction with calibrated versus observed-response targets
rows.student_design: One deterministic support-to-held direction per drug-dose unit. CFRA labels are generated source-only with drug-level out-of-fold prediction. Predictors use molecular structure, dose and the target/query Vehicle baseline in a source-only 2,000-gene space.
rows.scope_boundary: Cell-line and plate-block effects are confounded. The unseen-compound confirmation is inconclusive at MCF7; positive target-macro effect does not establish success for every target.

footnotes.text: Counts are unique evaluated compounds within each analysis, not cells, wells, drug-dose rows, training runs or source-resource totals. Eligibility varies across endpoints and support budgets; counts must not be added across rows or panels.

Slash-separated counts follow increasing support budgets: 1/2/3 for CP and 1/2 for GE. A support budget k requires at least k + 1 distinct acquisition plates. Wells on the same plate are not counted as independent plates. Distinct plates do not establish biological or cross-site independence.

BBBC047 CP was acquired in U2OS cells. The linked GE records are matched by compound and experimental metadata; they are not same-cell co-measurements. The descriptive CP analysis includes 18,082 compounds. Independent CFRA evaluation uses 2,423/2,166 BBBC047 and 189/185 cpg0004 compounds at 1/3 support measurements, drawn from a held-out fraction of the original training set.

cpg0004-LINCS has A549 CP and linked GE measurements from an acquisition distinct from BBBC047. The displayed CP benchmark counts are the strict matched-reference subsets, not all 313 compounds in its original test partition. Linked GE contributes CP-update evidence; these figures do not establish external GE-target validation.

cpg0004 morphology counts are 110 for module agreement, 262 for top-25 overlap/direction, and 260/258 for dose-response contrasts. Downstream activity, mechanism, target and pathway-target retrieval use 262/140/146/184 compounds. The morphology reference excludes the current support row and averages four physical plate rows; support rotations are not independent repeats.

sci-Plex3 uses the two biological repeats rep1/rep2. Each held target has 183 previously seen drugs (613 drug-dose units); the 36 unseen drugs (115 units) form a subset of the common drug universe. Target Vehicle baselines are available at inference. Cell-line and plate-block transfer cannot be separated, and unseen-drug confirmation remains inconclusive at MCF7.

sources.supports: BBBC047 CP uses U2OS cells. Original resource covers 30,616 compounds in quadruplicate; this resource total is intentionally not used as the evaluated sample size.
